data.name: City of Oaths
data.detailed_description:
City of Oaths is a story-driven action-adventure crime game set in a dark, rain-soaked city ruled by broken promises and silent wars.

You play as Sam Romano, a 26-year-old taxi driver trying to survive in LyanSee City — a place where loyalty is bought with blood and every favor comes with a price. Struggling to pay his mother’s medical bills, Sam is pulled into the world of organized crime after a single wrong night behind the wheel.

What begins as simple jobs soon escalates into bank robberies, assassinations, and a full-scale mafia war between rival families. As the city descends into chaos, Sam must navigate betrayal, violence, and moral choices — all while being hunted by both criminals and the law.

This is not a power fantasy.
This is the story of a man slowly losing his old life — and becoming something else.

🔫 Key Features

  • Story-Rich Singleplayer Experience
    A cinematic, chapter-based narrative inspired by classic mafia dramas.

  • Open City Exploration
    Drive through LyanSee City’s districts, from neon-lit nightclubs to decaying industrial zones.

  • High-Stakes Crime Gameplay
    Bank heists, getaways, assassinations, and street-level mafia jobs.

  • Intense Driving & Chases
    Realistic driving mechanics with police pursuits and escape routes that matter.

  • Dark & Atmospheric World
    Rain, fog, neon lights, jazz tones, and a city that feels alive — and dangerous.

  • Third-Person Action
    Gunfights, cover-based combat, and tense close-quarters moments.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and up
  • Processor: i5 and up
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 and up
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo. Play with good stereo.
